notes: S3-FIX1 (decision 2026-11-17 #5): a zip without blobs holds one more entry, the zero-data directory entry foo/. A zero-data directory entry of the zip form is ignored for the layout of §11.1 and for whether blobs/ is present (§11.7 rule 3, §11.9 rule 4): blobs/ is present only through a file entry. The directory form is unchanged: a real directory outside the layout is E_CONTAINER_ENTRY, empty or not.
